summary_en: ¥3.5B upper limit, 2,900,000 shares (5.02% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), open-market purchase, Aug 10, 2026–Aug 9, 2027. All acquired shares to be cancelled by Aug 31, 2027. Rationale: ROE improvement and expanded shareholder returns under SANYO VISION 2028 strategy.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Terms for Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Sanyo Trading's board resolved on August 3, 2026 to initiate a share buyback program and authorize subsequent cancellation of all acquired shares. The company will repurchase up to 2,900,000 ordinary shares (5.02% of shares outstanding excluding treasury, computed as 2.9M ÷ 57.662M) for an aggregate upper limit of ¥3.5 billion via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition window runs from August 10, 2026 through August 9, 2027. All shares acquired under this program will be cancelled on August 31, 2027. The company states the program supports its SANYO VISION 2028 midterm plan, which targets ROE improvement and enhanced shareholder returns through a combination of progressive dividends (aiming for 30%+ payout ratio) and flexible, opportunistic buybacks calibrated to stock price levels and capital investment needs.
